figurative_meaning_en: an attractive thing, opportunity or facility to earn money
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায় এই মধুতে সবাই লোভ দেখায়।
example_sentences_in_english: There's a lot of honey in politics.
Everyone is tempted by the honey in this business.
note: Often used metaphorically to denote financial allure in professions like politics.
